coreClaim: Completing a generated reply evicts old prompt snapshots without running the global message-swipe migration or rewriting unrelated rows.

inScope: Prompt snapshot eviction after saved assistant replies

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Old prompt snapshots are removed only from stale assistant messages in the active chat and their associated swipes.
currentPathsOrFormats: messages rows with generationPromptSnapshot or generationPromptSnapshotsBySwipe
legacyPathsOrFormats: legacy cachedPrompt metadata that must remain untouched
outOfScopeClaims: This PR does not change memory recall, repetition checks, prompt construction, or provider calls.
Target-device latency is measured after the merged image is deployed.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Per-chat prompt snapshot retention invoked a global normalization and replacement of every message and swipe collection after nearly every saved assistant reply.
contractLaneGate.consumer: conversation and roleplay generation completion through chat_evict_prompt_snapshots
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Retaining the two newest assistant prompt snapshots may mutate only stale assistant rows in the requested chat and their swipes.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The Rust owner builds message and sidecar patches for stale assistant IDs, applies each collection as one targeted patch_many operation, and leaves global migration to explicit migration entrypoints.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src-tauri owns persistent row mutation and current-versus-legacy swipe representation.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not hide the delay in the TypeScript generation caller or skip eviction; the expensive mutation mechanics belong at the Rust persistence boundary.
regressionProof: The focused Rust test covers current sidecars, legacy embedded swipes, retained recent snapshots, preserved cachedPrompt, and an unrelated sidecar negative control.
The same test failed before the implementation because global migration removed the unrelated sidecar.

positiveRows.claim: Stale root and swipe prompt snapshots are removed while the two newest assistant snapshots remain.
Current sidecar rows are patched without dropping non-snapshot metadata.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused Rust test proves generationPromptSnapshot is removed while the sidecar sentinel remains true.

contradictionRows.claim: Eviction for chat-1 must not normalize or delete an unrelated sidecar for chat-2.
contradictionRows.evidence: The negative-control sidecar remains after eviction; this assertion failed against the previous global migration path.

contradictionRows.claim: Snapshot retention must not delete legacy cachedPrompt user metadata.
contradictionRows.evidence: The focused Rust test verifies the user row and cachedPrompt content remain unchanged.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Legacy embedded swipes remain embedded and lose only prompt snapshot keys.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The focused Rust test exercises an embedded swipe and verifies its generationPromptSnapshot is removed.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: The default keep-last-two policy preserves the two newest assistant snapshots.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The focused Rust test verifies assistant-mid and assistant-new retain generationPromptSnapshot.

untestedRows: Post-merge Raspberry Pi latency is verified after the matching prealpha image is deployed.

ownedFacts.description: The pre-fix Pi path spent most reply-completion time inside chat_evict_prompt_snapshots rather than prompt recall.
ownedFacts.evidence: The pre-fix Pi telemetry sample recorded 67 eviction calls with p50 16392 ms, p90 18763 ms, and 63 calls above one second.

ownedFacts.description: The previous eviction path called migrate_nested_message_swipes after any eviction, which lists and normalizes all messages and sidecars before replace_all_many.
ownedFacts.evidence: Derived from src-tauri/src/commands/storage/chats.rs and src-tauri/src/commands/storage/message_swipes.rs before this change.

manualBlockers.reason: The mutation-scope contract is covered locally; target-device timing requires the merged prealpha image and is the required deployment follow-up.

negativeRowsTested: Two newest assistant snapshots remain untouched
